📏 Compare $/Mile

Paste or type Load #s (comma, space, or one per line) — e.g. "STB-3369, 3650, 3663". You don't need to repeat the prefix. Trailer and Tri-Axle each number their own loads, so the same Load # can exist on both — narrow to one fleet below if that's happening to you.

A hypothetical lane — just city/state, no real load on the board. Base Rate, Rate to Truck, and FSC are all optional; leave any blank if you don't have a number yet. Base Rate is what you'd bill the customer — it's shown for reference only. Rate to Truck + FSC is what actually counts toward the $/mile total below, same as a real load's Est. Driver Pay.
